Look beneath the subject line.

Analyze locally. HTML is shown as text; links and attachments are never opened.

Basic text import only. MIME/base64 messages and images are not decoded.

Privacy & AI settings

Local analysis needs no account or API key and sends no email content. Session messages are kept in memory and cleared on reload.

Optional AI second opinion

Run the included Node service locally with an OpenAI API key and model name. After you explicitly request a second opinion, the selected email text is sent to OpenAI. The key stays on the server.

Checking local service…

Browser extension

The included Gmail extension analyzes visible, opened messages as they render. Its popup can request an AI opinion through your explicitly allowlisted local service. It does not read unseen mail, modify messages, or send mail.

Download extension ↓

No automated deletion, reporting, or quarantine. “Hold for review” changes only this demo session. URLs are never visited. No accuracy or zero-harm guarantee is claimed.
